''See also: [[Min Shuei Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Min Shuei, also known as the [[Winter Sage]] or the [[Frozen Blade|Sage of the Frozen Blade]], is a powerful combatant characterized by her white hair, tanned skin, and white robes. She utilizes ice-based [[sword madra]] and [[Authority|authority]] to manipulate her surroundings, often manifesting frost or blizzards during combat. Known for being highly volatile and wearing her emotions openly, she can range from intense fury to deep sorrow. Despite this temperament, which some perceive as childish, she is a formidable warrior capable of engaging in high-level combat against entities such as the [[Dreadgod]] and tearing apart illusions created by the [[Silent King]]. In her role as a mentor, she has sought to train [[Yerin]], advocating that the girl should be taught by a [[Sword Sage]]. She is also seen leading [[Archlord|Archlords]] in battle and engaging in technical disputes regarding combat methods. Her abilities include various techniques such as [[Striker]], [[Forger]], and [[Ruler]], and she wields a white-bladed [[sword]]. Throughout her interactions, she has demonstrated both immense passion for battle and moments of profound grief over the loss of talented individuals.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Min Shuei is a character with white hair. She carries two identical swords, one of which is white.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Acting as a peacemaker, Min Shuei serves as a teacher who is capable of instructing [[Yerin]] in almost any subject. She has expressed belief in [[Lindon]]'s ability to win and has engaged in arguments with [[Charity]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Min Shuei serves as a teacher to [[Yerin]], offering instruction and guidance on various matters. She also interacts with [[Charity]], with whom she argues and who once restrained her. Additionally, Min Shuei holds beliefs regarding [[Lindon]]'s ability to win.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Known as the [[Sage]] of [[Frozen Blade]], she possesses a silver flash inside her soul that has the power to cleanse techniques.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sage of Frozen Blade}} ===
